title: Pharmacogenetics and Pharmacogenomics as Enabling Technologies for Precision Drug Development and Personalized Therapy.

title: An Integrated Multi-Omics and Causal Inference Study Identifies a DNA Repair-Related Prognostic Biomarker in Gastric Cancer.
snippet: This study aims to identify biologically relevant genes associated with DNA repair pathways in gastric cancer (GC) by integrating multi-omics analyses with causal inference approaches.
